inputs.name: certs
inputs.description: Certificates to get, by name, each with the domains it covers, such as { example = ["example.com", "www.example.com"] }. Every host gets every certificate.

inputs.name: email
inputs.description: Email address for the ACME account. When null, the account is registered without one.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: How certbot answers the HTTP challenge: "standalone" runs its own server on port 80, "webroot" writes files under webroot_path for a web server already on port 80, "nginx" uses the running nginx.

inputs.name: webroot_path
inputs.description: Directory your web server serves on port 80, for method = "webroot".

inputs.name: staging
inputs.description: Use Let's Encrypt's staging server, whose certificates browsers don't trust and whose rate limits are far higher.

inputs.name: acme_server
inputs.description: ACME directory URL of another certificate authority. When null, Let's Encrypt.

inputs.name: deploy_hook
inputs.description: Shell command to run after a certificate is issued or renewed, such as "systemctl reload nginx".
